subtitle.en: Two views of the island as it stands, plus the current puzzle count.
subtitle.zh: 岛上当前样子的两张视图，外加目前的谜题数量。

blocks.en: We haven't done one of these in a while. Here's what the island looks like currently:

blocks.en: The current puzzle count is 497. (This is lower than last time; last time was an overcount, as we had some temporary duplicates in the world that were being counted mistakenly.)
blocks.zh: 目前的谜题数量是 497 个。（这比上次少；上次是多算了，因为世界里有些临时的重复物件被错误地统计了进去。）
